hero.alt: Man in a brown sport coat and foulard tie holding a coffee by a window

rows.alt: Man in a corduroy sport coat, white shirt and patterned tie
rows.copy: Sport coats with real shoulders, honest tweed and herringbone, and the occasional made-in-Italy find. Vintage tailoring built to outlast the season it was bought in.

rows.alt: Man in a corduroy jacket with a paisley silk tie and pale trousers
rows.copy: Made-in-USA silk from Brooks Brothers, Burberrys and Gant. Repp stripes, foulards and the odd wild print, each one hand-picked and priced to wear.

rows.alt: Man in a gingham shirt and pleated trousers by the sea
rows.copy: The oxford cloth button-down is the backbone of a good wardrobe. Gitman, Ralph Lauren and Brooks, with the collar roll that newer shirts never quite get right.

rows.alt: Man in a leather jacket, striped tie and wide black trousers against a blue wall
rows.copy: Pleated chinos, madras shorts and white denim. Trousers cut with a little room, the way they were made before everything got skinny.

focus.alt: Man in a vintage teal windbreaker and ball cap against a teal wall

about.alt: Man in a navy jacket, light denim and two-tone loafers in a studio
